title: THE PAUSE BOX KEYS IN ONE STYLE
why: Found by the whole-game bug hunt of 2026-10-08, on the 4K pause screenshot. In the list of keys on the pause box, most keys were in bold but MOUSE, LMB, RMB, 1-9 and TAB were in plain grey, so the line looked like two different styles, and TAB was listed twice with two jobs (TAB back out, then P / TAB pause). Every key is now in the same bold, P is listed as pause, and TAB is listed once, as the controls card says it: pause, or back out.
now: The pause box lists every key in the same bold, and TAB once.
